# Furniture fit (generated by tools/fit_furniture.py)

Rule from the family: **double = two students sharing (2 single beds, 2 study tables, 2 wardrobes) where there is enough space, otherwise single** (1 bed, 1 study table, 1 wardrobe). Room and toilet geometry is exactly as DRAWN.
Furniture sizes are from the brief, taken as the Wakefit models from the PG chat: single bed 2.05×0.95, 3-door sliding wardrobe 1.20 wide (0.55 deep, fits the drawn grey strips), standard desk 1.16×0.57, wall desk 0.90×0.45. All furniture is Wakefit, with measurements confirmed by the family.

A layout passes only if every item is inside the room and clear of walls, the other items, every door swing and every clearance zone (each bed 0.60 m on its open side, each wardrobe 0.60 m in front, each desk a 0.75 m chair zone). It also needs a **0.55 m walking path** (ASSUMED) from the room door to every bed side, wardrobe front, chair zone, and the toilet or terrace door. The first wardrobe goes in the architect's grey strip (takeoff Q7). Order tried: twin with standard desks, then twin with wall desks, then single.
